commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

sessionId.description: A session's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

attachments.description: Images or files sent with the text; none when absent.

kind.description: What an attachment is: an image (the adapter needs imageInput) or a file (fileInput).

data.description: Its bytes, in standard padded base64, at most 20971520 bytes decoded (the maxLength bounds it within two bytes; the environment checks the decoded size); the log never holds them.

items.description: An attachment as a client sends it: kind, name, media type and its bytes in base64.

model.description: The model for this run; the session's when absent.

effort.description: The reasoning effort for this run; null for the model's own; when absent, accounts.defaultEffort when the model takes it, else the model's own.

mode.description: The mode for this run, clamped to the client session's ceiling and the account's modes; the session's when absent.
